candidates.claim: The 401 case in the port details error view is handled inline (an error page with a Sign in button that navigates to "/") instead of redirecting to Sign-in with the target remembered. The code comment claims this follows B.6, but B.6 requires a redirect and redirect-back after auth.
candidates.evidence: B.6 Reject: "a 401/403 handled inline instead of via redirect / page-level info Message"; table row: "401 Unauthenticated | Redirect to Sign-in, remember target, redirect back after auth". Code: `if (errorCode === "UNAUTHORIZED") { return <RouteIdLevelDefaultError code={401} ... action={<Button ... onClick={() => navigate({ to: "/" })}>`

candidates.claim: The port details route loader was removed, so the port is fetched only inside the component through a React Query call. A.3 says data critical for rendering must come from the route loader. The head title also no longer shows the port name and is a hardcoded, untranslated "Port Details".
candidates.evidence: A.3: "Data critical for rendering a page must be fetched via the route's `loader` function rather than loading it inside the component body." Delta removes `loader: async ({ context, params }) => { ... getById.query ... }` and sets `head: () => ({ meta: [{ title: "Port Details" }] })`.
candidates.precedent: The flavors detail route (the B reference implementation) keeps its data fetch in the route layer. The removal is justified in the PR comment as avoiding a double request.

candidates.claim: The Status column renders the raw status string (`{port.status}` / `{router.status}`) in a DataGridCell instead of a Badge. The delta moves this cell, so it touches the line.
candidates.evidence: B.1 table: "Status indicators | `Badge`". Same in routers/-components/RouterTableRow.tsx:51 (`<DataGridCell>{router.status}</DataGridCell>`).
candidates.precedent: Both lists already used plain text before this delta, and the details views also use plain text.

candidates.claim: The new 403 info Message banners in the list views have no `mb-4`, so the spacing is not the approved Message banner margin.
candidates.evidence: B.3 Margin table: "`Message` banners | `mb-4`". `<Message variant="info" title={t`Insufficient Permissions`}>` has no className. The same applies to routers/-components/RoutersList.tsx:105 and ports/$portId.tsx:87, where the Stack has `mt-6` and the Message has no `mb-4`.
candidates.precedent: The Message is the only content on the page in the list views, so the visual impact is small.
